0022600130.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) visit the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, coming off a win) in the Kings' fourth game of the season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost 0-3 to the Spurs, most recently 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17.
